outlook:
What nLight says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenuesFor the fourth quarter of 2026, nLIGHT expects revenues to be in the range of $84 million to $90 million.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: gross margin and adjusted EBITDAnLIGHT expects overall gross margin to be in the range of 30% to 36%, with Products gross margin in the range of 40% to 46% and Advanced Development gross margin of approximately 8%. nLIGHT expects Adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $12 million to $18 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 5, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
